Grounded in regional policy

In March 2025, the Eastern Caribbean Central Bank published its data‑protection blueprint for the currency union. It recognizes data portability, your right to receive and move your own financial data to another provider without hindrance. That is the principle EZirates is built on: your data, moved with your consent, to show you your own money in one place. Full relaunch February 1, 2027.

Why EZirates

Why one application beats ten phone calls.

In the Caribbean, the best rates and premiums are rarely published. EZirates puts your single application in front of every provider at once, so they compete for you.

One application, every provider

Apply once and every bank, credit union and insurer in your market can respond. No driving door to door, no repeating paperwork.

The rates are not public. We make them compete.

Caribbean banks and insurers seldom post their best pricing. Side by side, with your application in hand, they put their real offer forward.

You stay in control

Your contact stays private until you accept an offer. We never sell your data. You choose the deal, or you walk away.

Bank-grade security

256-bit encryption on all data, the same standard the banks use.

Not a bank or insurer

EZirates is a technology platform. Licensed banks, credit unions and insurers make every decision and hold every account.

Documents auto-delete

Your sensitive documents are removed from our servers after 90 days.

Contact privacy

Your phone and email stay hidden from providers until you accept an offer. No spam calls.

About EZirates

The Caribbean's first digital financial services broker

Our Mission

EZirates exists to give Caribbean consumers something they've never had: the power to make every bank, credit union, and insurance company compete for their business, simultaneously, transparently, and from a single application.

For too long, getting a loan or insurance in the Caribbean meant driving from institution to institution, filling out the same paperwork multiple times, and never knowing if you got the best deal. EZirates changes that. One application. Every offer. Better rates. Better premiums. Save time. Save money.

Who We Are

EZirates Caribbean Financial Services Ltd. is registered in St. Kitts and Nevis, with licensing applications submitted in St. Maarten and St. Lucia. We are a licensed financial services broker, NOT a bank, lender, or insurance company. We don't make lending decisions or set rates. We connect you with the institutions that do, and we make them compete for you.

How We Make Money

EZirates is free for consumers, you will never pay us a fee. We earn revenue from financial institutions: referral fees when we send them qualified applications, transaction fees when loans are funded or policies are activated, and technology subscriptions from institutions that use our platform. Our compensation never affects the rates or premiums you see, those are set by the institutions themselves.

Your Data Is Protected

We use 256-bit encryption, the same standard banks use. Your contact information is hidden from providers until you accept an offer. Documents are automatically deleted after 90 days. We never sell your data. Read our full Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.
